intro.text: Defenders of Azimir who fight alongside deadeye spren as partners rather than swearing Radiant oaths.

description.text: Their relationship with deadeyes lets them bond Shardblades and regrow Plate after ordinary Stormlight disappears.
Maya brought thirty-seven deadeyes, but the group chose to expand cautiously.

items.text: Maya brought deadeyes and armor spren to Azimir. Their Blades and Plate helped Adolin, Yanagawn and the defenders hold the throne room until the contest began.
Yanagawn allowed the Unoathed to speak to him directly, giving him companions outside the usual imperial formalities.
